plain_english.headline: A market with no clear breadth lead, and quiet. Best fit: an inflation shock — commodities and rates up together.
because: Breadth is going sideways — neither the big names nor the average stock is leading.
Single stocks are moving about as much as the index. The index itself is quiet, with VIX at 14.3, lower than 95% of the past two years.
Option dealers are positioned in a way that damps moves — rallies get sold into and dips get bought.
Trend-following funds are mixed across the 18 markets we track, and none is at an extreme — the positioning is not crowded.
Big speculators are unusually long the dollar, gold, copper and 6 others; unusually short natural gas and the long bond (CFTC data to 2026-08-25).

1 warning sign lit: price is climbing while momentum falls. A further 13 showed up on individual markets. No single one of these is a reason to sell. They matter when several point the same way as the breadth reading.
plain_english.so_what: Own the average stock, not just the leaders — and collect premium against it. That is the closest fit rather than a clean one — 1 of its conditions are not met. Size at 1.00x your normal risk.
watch_for: If the dollar trades above 99.75 (0.7% away), trend funds start buying.
If the 2-year trades above 103.54 (0.9% away), trend funds start buying.
Watch for single stocks becoming more volatile while the index stays calm. That gap is the earliest warning we get.
This reading would strengthen if GLD flat (roc5 -4.4%, roc20 3.37%) reversed.
